thread:
claire: Postmortem uploaded — short summary: intermittent DNS resolver cache miss + LB sticky-session mismatch caused TLS handshake retries for cross-region traffic (eu-west-3 -> us-east-1). doc: https://redwood-internal/pms/248900.

tom: observed TLS err_rate spike ~07:13-07:21 UTC, SYN retransmits on edge LBs. Any quick mitigation?

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-110 created; alerts suppressed for 45m while mitigations applied. :white_check_mark:

lucy: immediate fixes we ran: 1) increased DNS TTL for impacted records to 600s (owner: lucy, done at 07:19 UTC) 2) cleared stale LB session table entries on a subset of edges (owner: ryan, done at 07:22 UTC) 3) paused an aggressive resolver purge job (owner: infra, paused).

ryan: after clearing session table, TLS err_rate fell from 5.8% -> 0.9% in ~8m. digging into why session affinity pointed to drained backends during route convergence.

claire: triage action items: A) add pre-publish affinity-check to ensure no sticky sessions point to soon-to-be-drained hosts (owner: ryan, ETA: 4d) B) add resolver-change guard that warns on TTL < 60s for multi-region services (owner: lucy, ETA: 48h) C) add LB session-table alert when >70% entries reference non-ready backends (owner: infra, ETA: 7d) D) add TLS-handshake canary broken down by src_region + lb-id (owner: tom, ETA: 36h).

lucy: filing JIRAs now: NET-540 (resolver-guard), OBS-275 (tls-canary), INFRA-840 (lb-session-alert), NET-541 (affinity-check).

tom: small runbook note 1: add a short checklist for "clear session table" and verify via tls_err_by_region panel. I'll add that to doc.

ryan: PR started for affinity-check: https://git.redwood/routing/PR-710  includes a dry-run and a safe-fallback. reviewers: @lucy @tom.

claire: I'll create the recurring-incident entry (pattern: resolver-cache-miss + session-affinity -> TLS retries) and add owners. ping here with blockers. closing thread for now. :sparkles:
